# Phase 04.3 — Background Indexing

Source of truth: [Proposal 04](../proposals/04-automatic-context-engine.md)  
Build plan reference: [04 build plan](../../.codebuddy/plans/04-automatic-context-engine-build-plan.md)

## Objective

Build repository indexing so CodeBuddy can know something useful about the
project before the user manually saves memory.

## Build targets

- Add `codebuddy index`.
- Add `codebuddy watch`.
- Respect `.gitignore`.
- Maintain file content hashes.
- Add file summaries.
- Add incremental updates for changed files only.
- Reuse the lightweight architecture map and current memory foundation where sensible.

## Must preserve

- Current `map` commands.
- Current memory/reindex behavior.
- Local-only and reviewable file model.

## Non-goals

- No full type-aware parser platform.
- No always-on hidden daemon by default.
- No forced background process after `codebuddy use`.

## Implementation notes

- Start simple and deterministic.
- Index only supported text/code files first.
- Degrade gracefully on large repos.
- Coalesce repeated file-save bursts.
- Make it safe to run on partially configured repos.

## Verification checklist

- `npm run typecheck`
- `npm run lint`
- targeted index/watch tests
- full `npm test` if indexing touches shared retrieval paths

## Codex / Claude execution prompt

```text
You are a senior software developer implementing Proposal 04 Phase 04.3 for
CodeBuddy.

Your mission:
Build repository indexing that creates useful summaries and incremental context
without turning CodeBuddy into a fragile parser platform.

What must be built:
- `codebuddy index`;
- `codebuddy watch`;
- content hashes;
- incremental refresh;
- file summaries;
- `.gitignore` respect;
- safe handling of unchanged files.

What must not be built in this phase:
- hidden always-on background daemon;
- language-everything parser stack;
- broad automatic memory extraction logic;
- suggestion engine behavior.

Engineering standards:
- prioritize deterministic behavior and clear invalidation rules;
- skip unsupported or overly large files safely;
- keep indexing errors isolated instead of crashing the whole workflow;
- design for testability and graceful degradation.

Before editing:
1. Review the current map/index-related code and repository file layout.
2. Decide how summaries and hashes are stored without violating local-first assumptions.
3. Identify what can be shared later by Phase 04.5 token-savings work.

Testing expectations:
- test unchanged-file skip behavior;
- test change detection;
- test ignore-path behavior;
- test small end-to-end indexing on fixture repos.
```

## Completion prompt

```text
Before marking Phase 04.3 complete:
1. Verify indexing helps build useful context before manual memory exists.
2. Verify unchanged files are skipped and changed files refresh correctly.
3. Run the relevant test/lint/typecheck commands.
4. Document any deliberate limitations in supported file types or watch behavior.
```
